query: My Nexa A14 screen looks distorted right after I received the phone, and I need a diagnostic test.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Screen Rotation Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Screen rotation fix

actions.description: It will rule out hardware damage

steps: Check for any cracks or other damage to the screen.
If the device's screen is damaged, contact Customer Support to set up service.

actions.description: It will adjust screen orientation settings

steps: Using two fingers, swipe down from the top of the screen to open the Quick settings panel.
Locate the screen orientation icon.
If you need to change your screen's orientation setting, switch between Portrait, Landscape, or Auto rotate by tapping the screen orientation icon.
Open an app.
Try rotating your screen by turning your device sideways.
Avoid touching the screen while rotating the device, as this can interfere with the rotation process.

actions.description: It will arrange expert help and service

steps: If the issue persists after completing all the above steps, contact Customer Support to arrange for service.

actions.description: It will refresh the phone system

steps: On devices with a Power button: Press and hold the Power button.
Tap Restart.
Tap Restart again to confirm.
On devices with a Side button: Using two fingers, swipe down from the top of the screen to open the Quick settings panel.
Tap the Power icon.
Tap Restart.
Tap Restart again to confirm.

actions.description: It will restore factory default settings

steps: Back up your data before proceeding with this step.
If the previous steps did not resolve the screen rotation issue, perform a factory data reset.
Navigate to and open Settings.
Search for and select Factory data reset.
Tap Factory data reset again.
Review the information presented.
Tap Reset.
Tap Delete all.
If prompted, enter your TechCorp account password.

actionableDeeplink.description: Open factory data reset settings under Reset
actionableDeeplink.message: Go to factory data reset in Reset
